thread:
Asha: Quick sync — pulling the weekly KPIs and webinar benchmark before EOD. Need a fast triage on attribution noise from last launch.
Miles: Got it. I already see a weird bump in 'direct' channel leads for the webinar landing between 03:10–03:25 UTC. Might be duplicate UTM strip.
Riley: @Miles can you paste the query? I can run a session-level dedupe and check referrer headers.
Miles: Sure — snippet: `SELECT referrer, utm_source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2024-05-23T03:00:00Z' AND '2024-05-23T04:00:00Z' GROUP BY 1,2` — results look ~40% direct vs usual 12%.
Ben: Did we push a redirect change on the webinar page yesterday? That pattern usually follows a CDN redirect loop.
Sophia: No infra deploy that I know of. Marketing only edited the eventbrite link copy. Marco, any known campaign blasts at that time?
Marco: We sent a small influencer DM blitz at 03:05 UTC but links had tracking params. They should show as referral. :thinking:
Riley: If link shorteners are stripping params, analytics would show direct. I'll check the shortener logs (bitly account) now.
analytics-bot: bitly: 12 clicks for the campaign shortlink between 03:00–03:30, all with `?utm=...` present on final url.
Miles: Huh. So clicks preserved. Maybe client-side redirect on landing dropped params — older GA snippet we rolled back last week?
Asha: Important: For weekly dashboard freeze today, we need to annotate the KPI spike either as 'bot/instrumentation' or 'campaign' — decide quickly so reporting doesn't mislead execs.
Sophia: My vote: mark as 'campaign attribution mismatch' and add note to dashboard. We can revert if Riley finds clear instrumentation fault.
Ben: Agreed. Also add an action item to update the dashboard tooltip: "Attribution heuristics may change with link shortener/client redirects".
Riley: I ran a session-level dedupe — ~38 leads were double-submits from the same session; 20 of those had blank referrer. I'll open a short bug to force `document.referrer` capture on landing.
Marco: I'll notify the influencer cohort and ask them to use full-tracking links for the next push. Small fix but prevents noisy weekly signals.
Asha: Thanks team — Sophia, can you drop the dashboard annotation + the action item in the weekly KPI thread? I'll include a one-line blurb in the afternoon metrics email.
Sophia: On it. Adding note now. :memo:
Miles: Filed a quick ops ticket: #MK-487 to add server-side referrer fallback. Refer to Riley's session dedupe results attached.
Asha: Perfect — closing this sync. If anyone finds a different root cause ping me. :thumbsup:
